decisions.statement: A movement is matched by its amount and the days between the movement and the mail alone.
A charge is matched only by a movement out.
A refund is matched only by a movement in.
A charge's window opens on the order's own day and runs ten days.
A refund's window opens three days before the mail and runs twenty-one days after.
An order with no stated total matches nothing rather than matching on the date alone.
A movement several candidates account for is an ambiguity rather than a choice.
A movement no candidate accounts for is unmatched rather than dropped.
A note is cut to nine hundred characters.
The order number a note ends in is never cut.
A note names every item with its count or names the mail's summary where no item was read.
A product is named for a refund only where every line of that order names the same product.
Nothing here writes to Monarch or to a file.

definition: an Amazon order or refund matched against the card movement it accounts for
